segments.titleEn: A column looking for a hole
segments.ja: 調査兵団と駐屯の兵は、ウォール・ローゼの内側を穴のために歩きます。歩くほど、壊れた村は増えて、穴は増えません。増えないことが、今日の地図の中心です。エレンはまだ壁の内側の別の地点にいて、この列の足を自分の足のように感じます。感じても、現場の土は踏めていません。踏めない距離が、同期の危険を遠くではなく近くにします。近くなった危険を、彼は拳では触れません。触れない拳が、今日の彼の限界です。
segments.en: The Survey Corps and the garrison walk the inside of Wall Rose looking for a hole. The more they walk, the more broken villages there are, and the hole does not increase. That failure to increase is the center of today's map. Eren is still at another point inside the walls, and he feels the column's feet as his own. Even feeling them, he cannot step on the dirt of the scene. The distance he cannot step makes his classmates' danger near, not far. He cannot touch that nearer danger with a fist. The fist he cannot use is his limit today.

segments.ja: ハンジは、穴が無いことを事故の見落としとは扱いません。扱いを、壁そのものの性質へ移します。移すには、まだ司祭の言葉が要ります。言葉が無いあいだ、彼女はモブリットと馬で西側と南側を分けます。分ける作業は、巨人を倒す作業より地味です。地味な作業が、今日は本命です。本命の結果は、やはり穴が無い、です。無い結果が、今日の一番確かな報告です。確かな報告ほど、不安は大きいです。
segments.en: Hange does not treat the missing hole as an overlooked accident. She moves the treatment onto the nature of the wall itself. The move still needs the priest's words. While those words are absent, she and Moblit split west and south by horse. Splitting is plainer work than bringing Titans down. Plain work is the main task today. The result of the main task is, again, that there is no hole. The absence is today's most certain report. The more certain the report, the larger the unease.

segments.ja: アルミンは、見なかった穴を否定ではなくデータとして置きます。データは冷たいです。冷たいデータの横に、コニーの村とサシャの森が人の名で残ります。人の名を消さずに、次の方角を計算することが彼の仕事です。計算は南西を指します。南西には、まだ確認が薄い城の跡があります。跡へ向かうことが、夜までにできる最後の集まりです。集まりの名は、まだ城です。城の名は、ウトガルドです。
segments.en: Armin sets the hole they did not see down as data, not as a denial. The data is cold. Beside the cold data, Connie's village and Sasha's forest remain as people's names. His work is to calculate the next direction without erasing those names. The calculation points southwest. Southwest, there is the trace of a castle that has still been thinly checked. Heading for the trace is the last gathering that can be done before night. The name of the gathering is still a castle. The castle's name is Utgard.

segments.ja: 西南へ、という指示は短いです。短い指示が、別々の村にいた同期を一つの道へ集めます。ライナー、クリスタ、ユミル、コニー。ゲルガーがその道の上官として馬を見ます。見る目は、訓練の延長ではなく、夜の前の兵士の目です。兵士の目は、家族の話を切ります。切ったあとに残るのは、城までの距離と、巨人の足音の数です。数は、馬の数より多くなり始めています。
segments.en: The instruction to go southwest is short. The short instruction gathers classmates who had been in separate villages onto one road. Reiner, Christa, Ymir, Connie. Gelgar, as the officer on that road, watches the horses. The eyes that watch are not an extension of training. They are a soldier's eyes before night. Those eyes cut off talk of family. What remains after the cut is the distance to the castle and the number of Titan footsteps. The number is starting to exceed the horses.

segments.en: Reiner decides the position of the younger soldiers with his own back. The deciding looks, today, not like an imitation of an officer's work but like his real capacity. Ymir looks at that capacity with trust and suspicion at the same time. Even looking that way, she does not break the column. Not breaking it is her present method of protecting Christa. The method is valid until they reach the castle. The night after arrival starts to demand a different method. The demand is not words yet.

segments.ja: 城に入って分かったのは、立体機動と刃が人数分無いことです。無い装備で夜を越すには、石の上から落とすか、扉を閉じるかです。閉じた扉は、巨人の手が届くまでしか持ちません。届いたあとの戦いは、兵士の体そのものになります。ライナーはその戦いを、自分の体で引き受ける顔をします。顔を、ユミルは記憶の中の別の戦いと重ねて見ます。重ねた記憶は、まだ列には出しません。
segments.en: What becomes clear after entering the castle is that there is not enough ODM gear and blades for the number of people. To get through the night without that gear, you drop things from the stone or you shut the doors. A shut door lasts only until a Titan's hand reaches it. The fight after it reaches becomes the soldier's body itself. Reiner wears the face of someone who will take that fight with his own body. Ymir looks at the face laid over a different fight inside her memory. She does not put the overlaid memory into the column yet.

segments.en: Inside the castle, Connie repeats once the story of the Titan on the house. The voice that repeats it is small, and it does not vanish. Ymir sets the voice that will not vanish outside strategy for now. Setting it outside is to keep him on the side that lives tonight. Christa does not add a question. The kindness of not adding one reaches Connie. Even reaching him, the place of his mother stays inside his head. The place that stays is his weight tonight.

segments.ja: ユミルの中で、巨人化という言葉が意志として目を覚まし始めます。目覚めは、まだ行動ではありません。行動にするには、クリスタを失う未来が見える必要があります。未来は、塔の下に集まる巨人の数とともに濃くなります。濃くなるのを、彼女はライナーの背中と比べます。背中が持つ限界と、自分の秘密の限界は、別の種類です。別の種類を、今夜はまだ開けません。開けない選択は、塔が持つあいだだけ有効です。
segments.en: Inside Ymir, the word titanization starts to wake as a will. The waking is not yet an action. To make it an action, she needs to see a future in which Christa is lost. The future thickens together with the number of Titans gathering under the tower. She compares the thickening with Reiner's back. The limit that back has, and the limit of her own secret, are different kinds. She does not open the different kind tonight yet. The choice to keep it shut is valid only while the tower holds.

segments.en: Away from the castle, Erwin lines up the reports that contain no hole. The conclusion he lines up is that Wall Rose has not been broken, and yet Titans are inside. The conclusion does not narrow the operation to one. While it cannot narrow, he holds back permission to send Eren south. Holding back means putting the Beast Titan, the invisible way in, and Nick's secret on the same shelf. The shelf still has no label tonight. The Commander watches the unlabeled shelf until morning.

The method is valid until they reach the castle. The night after arrival starts to demand a different method. The demand is not words yet.

vocab.exampleJa: データは冷たいです。
vocab.exampleEn: Armin sets the hole they did not see down as data, not as a denial. The data is cold. Beside the cold data, Connie's village and Sasha's forest remain as people's names. His work is to calculate the next direction without erasing those names. The calculation points southwest. Southwest, there is the trace of a castle that has still been thinly checked. Heading for the trace is the last gathering that can be done before night. The name of the gathering is still a castle. The castle's name is Utgard.

vocab.exampleJa: 話の枠が、現場に追いついていません。
vocab.exampleEn: From another road, Hannes reports again that there is no hole. The voice that repeats it is a voice that has known Eren since Shiganshina. The voice that knows him brings, today, a sight close to villages wiped out. Even bringing it, he still talks about Titans as a threat from outside the wall. The frame of the talk has not caught up to the scene. Armin does not deny the frame that has not caught up. He only leaves the hole's column empty. The blank is tonight's conclusion.
